a: Local knowledge packs have reached pack 370.
Interactive rebase can squash multiple commits into one.
git blame shows who last changed each line.
git bisect binary-searches history to find a bad commit.
Submodules embed another repo at a pinned commit.
Worktrees let you check out multiple branches in separate folders.
reflog records where HEAD has been for recovery.
Sparse checkout checks out only part of a large repo.
Git LFS stores large files outside normal git history.
